citations.title: Kenya anchors 30M+ academic credentials on Avalanche for instant, forgery-resistant verification
DeFi Kingdoms sunsets DFK Chain August 28, migrates player assets to Avalanche C-Chain and plans third-party SDK

summary: Avalanche is a high-throughput Layer-1 built around customizable application chains. Its case rests on institutional settlement, tokenization, and consumer deployments, balanced against liquidity fragmentation, bridge risk, competition, and uncertain token demand.
